j4rj48px.variantName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Cairngorm Pine Outdoor Potted Tree
j4rj48px.sourceDescription: Set the festive tone before guests enter your home with this elegant outdoor 3ft Christmas tree. Where to begin with the enchanting attributes of the Cairngorm Pine? First, there are the extremely realistic plastic-moulded branch tips which look stunning studded with outdoor Christmas lights. Then, there is the traditional two-tone green far superior to the solid greens of many outdoor Christmas trees. And let's not forget the attached hinged branches which make assembly so simple. Plus, we've thrown in some pretty plastic pinecones for good measure. It is Christmas, after all! tvrb68h8.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Snowy LED Frosted Pine Fibre Optic Tree
tvrb68h8.sourceDescription: Following in the footsteps of our popular Snowy Scots Pine tree, this 8ft fibre optic tree is the ideal festive antidote to dull evenings. Coming with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches, mini acrylic flowers, berries and pre-attached pine cones, it really is a stunning 8ft fibre optic tree that you'll be eager to display in your home. Many of our customers love this tree as it offers a more low-key version of a fully frosted Christmas tree and doesn't demand attention like our all-over kaleidoscopic fibre optics. An affordable option for anyone looking to light up their home with a sprinkling of Yuletide charm, the 8ft Snowy Frosted Pine fibre optic tree is the ultimate choice for any Xmas lover! Picture shows 6ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. nnr0a43c.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Pre-shaped - Green - 150 cm
nnr0a43c.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Pre-shaped - Green - 150 cm
nnr0a43c.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 150 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

Designed with ultra-durable, weather-resistant, waterproof polyester and featuring an internal white LED glow, this holiday display will create a festive focal point in your yard, invoking the holiday spirit for years to come.
